name: linear-ticket-creator
title: 线性票证创建器
description: Generate well-structured Linear tickets from bugs, features, and improvements. Explores the codebase to auto-populate technical notes, acceptance criteria, and scope. TRIGGER when: user asks to create a Linear ticket, write a ticket, draft a bug report, or convert a requirement into a ticket. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user is working on code, asking general questions, or managing existing tickets.
